question.worked_solution:
We need to isolate all terms with $m$ on one side of the equation. To do this, we subtract $4$ to both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}2mn+m+4 & =7 \\ 2mn+m+4-4 & =7-4 \\ 2mn+m & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we factor out $m$ in the expression on the left-hand side.

$$
\begin{aligned}2mn+m & =3 \\ m(2n+1) & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we divide both sides by $(2n+1)$ to isolate $m:$

$$
\begin{aligned}m(2n+1) & =3 \\ \frac{m(2n+1)}{2n+1} & =\frac{3}{2n+1} \\ \frac{m\cancel{(2n+1)}}{\cancel{2n+1}} & =\frac{3}{2n+1} \\ m & =\frac{3}{2n+1}\end{aligned}
$$

**Note:** This result assumes that $2n+1\ne 0.$
